subject.title: fix(gateway): skip secrets.resolve when target SecretRefs use exec providers

question: Should command-secret resolution skip the gateway RPC for active exec-backed target SecretRefs and resolve them locally when local exec is allowed?
rationale: The code and proof support the bug fix, but the remaining choice is whether OpenClaw should intentionally route active provider exec SecretRefs around the gateway snapshot path before trying the RPC.

options.title: Accept the guarded skip
options.body: Land this PR after refresh, keeping the active-target, inactive-target, and no-local-exec safeguards as the intended command-secret behavior.

options.title: Keep gateway-first semantics
options.body: Reject or close this PR and tolerate the current recoverable `UNAVAILABLE` noise until a different contract is designed.

options.title: Require runtime-side redesign
options.body: Supersede this PR with a broader gateway/runtime-command-secret change that can return partial snapshot success instead of changing CLI preflight behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept the guarded skip
recommendation.body: Land this PR after refresh, keeping the active-target, inactive-target, and no-local-exec safeguards as the intended command-secret behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to steipete, and the remaining blocker is acceptance of the auth/security-sensitive routing boundary rather than a narrow code repair.
